newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - June 8.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - June 8.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Kuwaiti acting prime minister says foreign hands behind attempt on life of member of parliament.
- An Iraqi team to arrive in Damascus next Friday for talks with officials to boost trade cooperation.
- Kuwait to extend $66 million to Syria to finance a telephone project.
- Saudi Development Fund agrees to extend 113 million riyals to seven new industrial projects.
- A U.S. official says oil-for-food agreement with Iraq will stay for long.
- Around $50 billion worth of assets being managed by Islamic banks in Gulf Arab states.
- Jordanian, Syrian officials hold talks in Damascus to enhance economic relations between the two countries.
